verified_role: Director & Head of the Department - Cardiac Electrophysiology, AIG Hospitals, Gachibowli, Hyderabad; Senior Consultant Cardiologist & Electrophysiologist
verified_experience: 42-43 years in cardiology (MBBS 1982, MD General Medicine 1985, DM Cardiology 1992). Source row carried no experience figure.
hni_signals: Nationally prominent electrophysiologist and a top-tier HNI candidate. (1) DEPARTMENT LEADERSHIP: 'Director & Head of the Department - Electrophysiology, AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad' (public billing on a Bayer 4 Health India CME session); Head of Cardiac Electrophysiology at AIG Hospitals; Senior Consultant Cardiologist & Electrophysiologist. (2) PRIOR LEADERSHIP: previously Head of the Electrophysiology Department at CARE Hospitals, Hyderabad - he built and led that unit for many years before moving to AIG (still shown on some legacy directory listings). (3) SOCIETY OFFICE: President, Indian Society of Electrocardiology. (4) PIONEER STATUS: repeatedly described in public profiles as 'a pioneer in the field of Electrophysiology / Electrocardiology in India' who 'has performed numerous minimally invasive procedures for the management of heart rhythm disorders'; AIG's EP unit is publicly credited with introducing Telangana's first pulse field ablation procedure for atrial fibrillation (Telangana Today: https://telanganatoday.com/aig-hospitals-introduces-telanganas-first-pulse-field-ablation-procedure-for-atrial-fibrillation). (5) INTERNATIONAL TRAINING: fellowships in clinical electrophysiology and clinical vascular cardiology in the USA. (6) ACADEMIC PEDIGREE + AWARDS: MD Internal Medicine, University of Madras / Madras Medical College; DM Cardiology, Christian Medical College Vellore; University Gold Medal in the DM (Fellowship) examination, 1992. (7) TEACHING/CONFERENCE FACULTY: listed as faculty on Medical Learning Hub CME platform and fronts recorded educational lectures (e.g. 'ECGs in Pace Maker'), and is a listed HCP/KOL on Medtalks. (8) GOVERNMENT MEDICAL-VALUE-TRAVEL LISTING: carried on the Government of India Advantage Healthcare India directory as the AIG electrophysiology specialist, a designation reserved for consultants a hospital markets to international patients. No specific procedure volume figure was published, so none is recorded. No evidence of an owned private clinic - he practises within AIG.
